name: Playwright
description: Lets QA and SWE agents write Playwright test specs from testing procedures produced by tool.ac-to-testing, and during ticket work the tester can also generate annotated verification videos and AC walkthrough docs on request; specs, config, and walkthroughs live outside the work repo under a durable per-repo scope directory, while test-results, the HTML report, videos, and the Edge profile are nested one level deeper under a per-session run directory, so concurrent Playwright sessions in different repos AND in the same repo cannot contaminate each other's output. Verification videos record from a context created only after sign-in and app bootstrap have finished, and each produced .webm is stream-copy remuxed afterwards when ffmpeg is available, so a video neither opens on a blank viewport nor carries a wrong container duration. A blank-video report is triaged by checking the container header first, since that one command separates the blank-lead-in cause from the bad-header cause and tells the agent which fix applies; the checks and the byte-step measurement that sizes a lead-in run on Playwright's own bundled ffmpeg, so they work on a machine with no system ffmpeg and no ffprobe at all.

specsDir.label: Specs Dir
specsDir.description: Root dir for Playwright specs. Creates a per-repo scope dir (specs, config, walkthrough) and a per-ticket subdir; per-run output nests under runs/<session-id>/ so concurrent sessions in the same repo don't collide. Specs persist; run dirs are the operator's to prune.

configTemplate.label: Config Template
configTemplate.description: Shape of the generated playwright.config.ts. base-url-env (default): reads BASE_URL from env and throws if unset (recommended). hardcoded-base-url: pins an explicit URL you supply. minimal: is bare-bones. No template ever guesses a base URL.

autoOfferOnProcedures.label: Auto-Offer On Procedures
autoOfferOnProcedures.description: When on, QA proactively offers to write specs when fresh testing procedures are added to ticket notes. Off requires an explicit request. Default on.

specPerProcedure.label: Spec Per Procedure
specPerProcedure.description: When on, generates one spec file per testing procedure (TP-1.spec.ts, etc). Off consolidates all TPs into one file per ticket. Default on.

includeSetupTeardown.label: Include Setup Teardown
includeSetupTeardown.description: When on, generated specs include beforeAll/afterAll hooks for setup and cleanup. Off produces pure test() blocks with no shared setup. Default on.

edgeProfileAuth.label: Edge Profile Auth
edgeProfileAuth.description: When on, specs use Edge's persistent profile for Azure AD auth instead of programmatic login. Required for apps behind Azure AD. Default off.

edgeProfilePath.label: Edge Profile Path
edgeProfilePath.description: Path to the Edge profile used for auth. Default's <scope>/<session> tokens give every session its own profile (re-sign-in each time). Drop <session> to share one profile per repo (one session at a time); a fixed path reuses an existing signed-in profile (one session anywhere). No effect when Edge Profile Auth is off.

authChannelOverride.label: Auth Channel Override
authChannelOverride.description: Browser channel passed as channel: to chromium.launchPersistentContext() for auth-context specs; no effect when Edge Profile Auth is off. msedge (default): the stable channel. msedge-beta: a non-stable channel. msedge-dev: a non-stable channel.

verificationVideo.label: Verification Video
verificationVideo.description: Controls recording of annotated verification videos. on-request (default): only when asked. always: for every spec generation. off: never. Ticket work only. Setup/sign-in is excluded from the recording, and each video is remuxed via ffmpeg (system or bundled) to fix duration; if no ffmpeg resolves at all, the raw video ships with a note.

annotateVideoSteps.label: Annotate Video Steps
annotateVideoSteps.description: When on, injects an on-page caption banner per test.step so the recorded video carries step narration. When off, video records with no overlay.

acWalkthrough.label: AC Walkthrough
acWalkthrough.description: Controls writing an AC-walkthrough.md alongside specs. on-request (default): only when asked. always: with every spec generation. off: never. Ticket work only.
